lead.headline: McLaurin's season is over — claim Metcalf before 01:00
lead.deck: Tuesday's MRI confirmed season-ending surgery; the bye swaps are made and the lineup is the projection lineup.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Terry McLaurin's MRI came back this afternoon: season-ending knee surgery. Chem has no IR slot, so he is a dead roster spot, and the one move left before waivers process at 01:00 is the claim this morning's brief proposed — DK Metcalf, Pittsburgh's WR1, for McLaurin. Priority resets weekly, so it costs nothing lasting. The three bye swaps landed: Love, Gordon and Jefferson are in, the lineup projects 129.5 against JuiceJam's 90.2, and ESPN makes AVIATO a 71% favourite.

doFirst.headline: One claim tonight — the window closes at 01:00
doFirst.deck: Claim Metcalf, drop McLaurin, before waivers process at 01:00 Wednesday CDMX.
doFirst.note: Hold the Patriots D/ST (seat changed six days ago) and Fairbairn (ties the best kicker on the wire). The lineup needs nothing else.
doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide — the lineup is the projection lineup.

cards.headline: Claim DK Metcalf, drop McLaurin — before 01:00
cards.reason: McLaurin needs season-ending knee surgery (Yahoo, 20 Oct) and Chem has no IR slot. Metcalf drew 15 targets in Week 6 and is a starter on Pittsburgh's depth chart. This is the last brief before claims lock.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup — this morning's three bye swaps landed.

wire.headline: Claim Metcalf tonight; Mayer is next week's tight end
wire.deck: Metcalf's role is Pittsburgh's WR1, not a vacancy. Everything else on the screen is a bye, a borrowed role or a backfield in flux.

4262921.deck: Back from the bye; starts over Allgeier.
4262921.reason: Murray the incumbent; Addison and Hockenson may return
4262921.availability: ACTIVE — no current injury listed (Athlon 19 Oct); Minnesota off a Week 6 bye
4262921.competition: Jordan Addison (hamstring) and T.J. Hockenson (concussion) both 'status TBD' coming out of the bye (DK Network 20 Oct). RIVAL_QUESTIONABLE answered: if both return his share falls back toward Weeks 1-2, not below WR1
4262921.passer: Kyler Murray, the starter since Week 3; Minnesota have not formally named him for Week 7 (Football Nation USA 20 Oct). QB_CHANGE answered: the tool's 'J.J. McCarthy' is stale — McCarthy is now a Giant
4262921.checked: DK Network Week 7 injury report 20 Oct 13:31Z; Football Nation USA Colts-Vikings guide 20 Oct; Big Lead PPR ranks (WR13) — Minnesota's first practice report is Wednesday

vsProjection.text: Addison and Hockenson's timelines broke 11-13 Oct; the 18.6 was set after.

4262921.logic: 18.6 against Allgeier's 7.3 in the flex chain — an 11.3 gap, not close. Indianapolis rank 13th against receivers. Changes only if Minnesota name a quarterback other than Murray.
